pirs.statement: Will the KU committee pass Prop. 2025/26:258 including the labor organizations contributions law unchanged?
pirs.trigger: KU betänkande published with committee recommendation on Prop. 2025/26:258

pirs.statement: Will Liberalerna (L) publicly dissent on the labor org contributions section, potentially changing the vote arithmetic?
pirs.trigger: L public statement or committee reservation opposing the labor org contributions law

pirs.statement: Will other opposition parties (S, V, MP) file their own motions on Prop. 2025/26:258?
pirs.trigger: New motions filed citing Prop. 2025/26:258 in riksdag-regering

pirs.statement: Will the government respond to Lagrådet's 'bräckligt' criticism with amendments before the KU vote?
pirs.trigger: Government press release or supplementary proposition amending the labor org contributions section
